title: Stop Saying "Very Good"! 5 Better English Words #shorts
description:
Stop saying "very good". Try one of these instead:
• Excellent: an excellent idea
• Superb: a superb meal
• Fantastic: a fantastic view
• Outstanding: an outstanding result
• Brilliant: a brilliant plan

Which one will you use today? Write it in the comments.
